summary: Round-1's blocking F1 is resolved, witnessed by running vars/cicd.groovy unmodified under Temurin 17 + groovy-all 2.4.21 with Jenkins steps stubbed and a local bare remote seeded from P1's real stage files: the pre-fix commit fails the interpolated-key caller with 'config/dev/values.yaml names no pins', the fix commit writes all fourteen pins in one commit. Every applyPins guard survives the wanted->pins rename, V02 holds end to end (7 lines per file, nothing else touched, values round-trip as strings, a re-run pushes nothing), and all seven vars/*.groovy parse. One new finding, Minor and advisory: the duplicate-key guard this commit adds covers the values-file map and not the pins map.

findings.summary: normalizePins throws on a values file named twice (:154-157) but silently collapses two keys naming one YAML path (:161), dropping a pin with a success return.
